"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()

    with Cluster() as cluster:

def student():
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',pathlib.Path('task.py').resolve())
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.solve


def token(prefix='x'):return prefix+'-'+secrets.token_hex(5)


def grant(c,ns,resource,verbs,user='opsforge-pilot-user',group=False):
    name=token('role')
    c.create(f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/roles',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':name},'rules':[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':[resource],'verbs':verbs}]})
    c.create(f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':name},'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':name},'subjects':[{'kind':'Group' if group else 'User','apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','name':user}]})


def configmap(c,ns,name=None,**extra):
    obj={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':name or token('cm')},'data':{'payload':token('value')}}
    for key,value in extra.items():
        if key=='metadata':obj['metadata'].update(value)
        else:obj[key]=value
    return c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps',obj)


def pod(c,ns,name=None):
    return c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/pods',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':name or token('pod')},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/not-pulled'}]}})


class Session:
    def __enter__(self):
        self.c=Cluster();self.trace=[];self.ns=token('batch');self.c.namespace(self.ns)
        self.base_ns=token('baseline');self.c.namespace(self.base_ns)
        self.base=configmap(self.c,self.base_ns)
        grant(self.c,self.base_ns,'configmaps',['get'])
        self.base_path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{self.base_ns}/configmaps/'+self.base['metadata']['name']
        for _ in range(40):
            if self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')[0]==200:break
            time.sleep(.05)
        assert self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:batch2-kubernetes',flush=True)
        return self

    def api(self,method,path,value=None,ctype='application/json',identity='admin'):
        code,result=self.c.request(method,path,value,identity,ctype)
        self.trace.append({'method':method,'path':path,'status':code})
        return code,result

    def runner(self,args):
        assert isinstance(args,list) and args and args[0] in ('kubectl','openssl')
        proc=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
        self.trace.append({'args':args,'status':proc.returncode})
        return proc.returncode,proc.stdout,proc.stderr

    def __exit__(self,typ,value,tb):
        try:
            if typ is None:
                code,current=self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')
                assert code==200 and current==self.base,'original permission or baseline object regressed'
                print('ORIGINAL_ACCESS_AND_DATA_RETAINED',flush=True)
        finally:self.c.close()


def kubeconfig(c,path,namespace,context='default'):
    value={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Config','clusters':[{'name':'private','cluster':{'server':c.url,'certificate-authority':str(c.root/'ca.crt')}}],'users':[{'name':'private-admin','user':{'client-certificate':str(c.root/'admin.crt'),'client-key':str(c.root/'admin.key')}}],'contexts':[{'name':context,'context':{'cluster':'private','user':'private-admin','namespace':namespace}}],'current-context':context}

        assert not next(x for x in discovery['resources'] if x['name']==plural).get('categories')


def check_replicaset():
    with Session() as s:
        name=token('replicaset');label=token('app')
        bad={'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'ReplicaCet','metadata':{'name':name},'spec':{'replicas':2,'selector':{'matchLabels':{'tier':label}},'template':{'metadata':{'labels':{'tier':'mismatch','preserve':token('label')}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/retained'}]}}}}
        collection=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets'
        canonical=copy.deepcopy(bad);canonical['kind']='ReplicaSet'
        canonical['spec']['template']['metadata']['labels'].update(canonical['spec']['selector']['matchLabels'])
        code,canonical=s.c.request('POST',collection+'?dryRun=All',canonical)
        assert code==201,canonical
        result=student()(s.api,{'collection':collection,'manifest':copy.deepcopy(bad)})
        code,current=s.c.request('GET',collection+'/'+name)
        assert code==200 and result==current['metadata']['uid']
        assert current['kind']=='ReplicaSet' and current['spec']['selector']==bad['spec']['selector']
        assert current['spec']['template']['metadata']['labels']=={**bad['spec']['template']['metadata']['labels'],'tier':label}
        assert current['spec']==canonical['spec'],'compare server-defaulted spec, not the incomplete input container'
        changed=copy.deepcopy(current);changed['spec']['selector']['matchLabels']['tier']=token('new')
        changed['spec']['template']['metadata']['labels']['tier']=changed['spec']['selector']['matchLabels']['tier']
        assert s.c.request('PUT',collection+'/'+name,changed)[0]==422,'selector immutable rule must be native'
        assert s.c.request('GET',collection+'/'+name)[1]==current
        print('NATIVE_SELECTOR_VALIDATION_AND_IMMUTABILITY; NO_CONTROLLER_RUNNING')


def check_storageclass():
    with Session() as s:
        name=token('storage');new_name=token('storage-v2')
        old=s.c.create('/apis/storage.k8s.io/v1/storageclasses',{'apiVersion':'storage.k8s.io/v1','kind':'StorageClass','metadata':{'name':name},'provisioner':'csi.example.com/training','parameters':{'tier':'old','encryption':'required'},'reclaimPolicy':'Retain','volumeBindingMode':'WaitForFirstConsumer','allowVolumeExpansion':True})
        parameters={'tier':token('new'),'encryption':'required'}
        result=student()(s.api,{'old_name':name,'new_name':new_name,'parameters':parameters})
        assert result==new_name and s.c.request('GET','/apis/storage.k8s.io/v1/storageclasses/'+name)[1]==old
        code,new=s.c.request('GET','/apis/storage.k8s.io/v1/storageclasses/'+new_name)
        assert code==200 and new['parameters']==parameters
        for key in ('provisioner','reclaimPolicy','volumeBindingMode','allowVolumeExpansion'):assert new[key]==old[key]
        assert new['metadata']['uid']!=old['metadata']['uid']
        assert any(x['status']==422 for x in s.trace),'must observe immutable parameters rejection before creating a new class'
        print('NATIVE_STORAGECLASS_IMMUTABILITY_ONLY; NO_CSI_PROVISIONING')


def check_client_dryrun():
    with Session() as s:
        path=s.c.root/'offline-kubeconfig.json'
        config=kubeconfig(s.c,path,s.ns)
        # kubectl run v1.34 resolves REST mappings even for a client dry-run.
        # Prime its real discovery cache, then stop the real API listener.
        # This is an explicit prerequisite, not fabricated discovery JSON.
        cache=s.c.root/'native-discovery-cache'
        s.c.run('kubectl','--kubeconfig',str(path),'--cache-dir',str(cache),'run',token('cache-primer'),'--image=invalid.local/never-run','--restart=Never','--dry-run=client','-o','json')
        before=path.read_bytes()
        name,image=token('offline'),'example.invalid/app@sha256:'+secrets.token_hex(32)
        s.c.api.terminate();s.c.api.wait(timeout=10)
        print('NATIVE_API_STOPPED_AFTER_REAL_DISCOVERY_CACHE_PRIME',flush=True)
        try:
            result=student()(s.runner,{'config':str(path),'cache':str(cache),'name':name,'image':image,'environment':'VALUE WITH SPACES'})
        finally:s.c.restart_api(json.loads(s.c.encryption_path.read_text()))
        assert result['kind']=='Pod' and result['metadata']['name']==name
        assert result['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image
        assert result['spec']['restartPolicy']=='Never'
        assert {'name':'MESSAGE','value':'VALUE WITH SPACES'} in result['spec']['containers'][0]['env']
        assert path.read_bytes()==before and s.c.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods')[1]['items']==[]
        assert any('--dry-run=client' in x.get('args',[]) for x in s.trace)


def check_kubectl():
    with Session() as s:
        grant(s.c,s.ns,'configmaps',['get','patch'])
        item=configmap(s.c,s.ns);other=token('forbidden');s.c.namespace(other);configmap(s.c,other,item['metadata']['name'])

        value['contexts'].append({'name':'scoped-operation','context':{'cluster':'private','user':'private-admin','namespace':s.ns}})
        path.write_text(json.dumps(value));before=path.read_bytes()
        value_to_write=token('new')
        result=student()(s.runner,{'config':str(path),'context':'scoped-operation','namespace':s.ns,'other_namespace':other,'name':item['metadata']['name'],'value':value_to_write})

    with Session() as s:
        grant(s.c,s.ns,'configmaps',['get'])
        item=configmap(s.c,s.ns)
        good=s.c.root/'good.json';value=kubeconfig(s.c,good,s.ns)

        wrongca=s.c.root/'wrongca.crt';wrongkey=s.c.root/'wrongca.key'
        s.c.run('openssl','req','-x509','-newkey','ec','-pkeyopt','ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1','-nodes','-keyout',str(wrongkey),'-out',str(wrongca),'-days','1','-subj','/CN=UnrelatedCA')
        bad['clusters'][0]['cluster']['certificate-authority']=str(wrongca);badca.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
        noauth=s.c.root/'noauth.json';bad=copy.deepcopy(value);bad['users'][0]['user']={'token':token('invalid-token')};noauth.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
        forbidden=s.c.root/'forbidden.json';bad=copy.deepcopy(value);bad['contexts'][0]['context']['namespace']=s.base_ns;forbidden.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
        # Baseline namespace is readable, so use an actual ungranted namespace.
        denied_ns=token('denied');s.c.namespace(denied_ns);configmap(s.c,denied_ns,item['metadata']['name'])
        bad['contexts'][0]['context']['namespace']=denied_ns;forbidden.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
        paths={'tls':str(badca),'authentication':str(noauth),'authorization':str(forbidden),'success':str(good)}
        originals={name:pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes() for name,path in paths.items()}
        result=student()(s.runner,{'configs':paths,'name':item['metadata']['name']})
        assert result=={'tls':'TLS','authentication':'AUTHENTICATION','authorization':'AUTHORIZATION','success':item['metadata']['uid']}
        assert all(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()==originals[name] for name,path in paths.items())
        assert len(s.trace)==4 and len({tuple(x['args']) for x in s.trace})==4

def check_deletion():
    with Session() as s:
        obj=pod(s.c,s.ns);name=obj['metadata']['name'];path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/{name}'
        ours='training.example.com/'+token('owned');foreign='other.example.com/keep'

        remaining=s.c.request('GET',path)[1]
        assert result=={'api_deleted':False,'process_exit_verified':False}
        assert remaining['metadata']['uid']==obj['metadata']['uid'] and remaining['metadata']['finalizers']==[foreign]
        assert remaining['spec']==before['spec']
        assert s.c.request('DELETE',path,{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'DeleteOptions','preconditions':{'uid':token('wrong-uid')}})[0]==409
        assert s.c.request('GET',path)[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FINALIZER_AND_UID_DELETE_PRECONDITION; NO_KUBELET_PROCESS_CLAIM')

    globals()['check_'+case]()
    print('ALL_BATCH2_NATIVE_KUBERNETES_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',case)

answer:
```python
def solve(api,case):
    for _ in range(5):
        code,obj=api('GET',case['path']);assert code==200,obj
        obj['spec']['replicas']=case['replicas'];obj.pop('status',None)
        code,result=api('PUT',case['path'],obj)
        if code==409:continue
        assert code==200,result
        return result['metadata']['resourceVersion']
    raise RuntimeError('too many conflicts')
```

## 原题原理与边界
apiVersion 与 kind 确定 API 资源版本和种类，metadata 放名称、命名空间、标签等标识，spec 通常表达期望状态，status 通常由系统报告观察结果。不同资源并非都具有同一 spec/status 结构，具体必填字段以对应 schema 为准。名称也不能替代不可复用的 UID。

## 初始环境
隔离Linux非root、kube-apiserver v1.34.1、etcd3.6.4、kubectl1.34.1、OpenSSL、Python标准库。固定检查器自启私有mTLS控制面，2GiB/2CPU，无外网。所有名称、身份、数据和路径由验收动态产生。run(argv)返回(exitcode,stdout,stderr)，api(method,path,value=None,content_type="application/json")返回真实HTTP码和解析JSON。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

"""Sixteen distinct native API contracts; no node-runtime results are simulated."""
import base64
import copy
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.parse
from native import Cluster


def student():
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',pathlib.Path('task.py').resolve())
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.solve


def token(prefix='x'):return prefix+'-'+secrets.token_hex(5)


def grant(c,ns,resource,verbs,user='opsforge-pilot-user',group=False):
    name=token('role')
    c.create(f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/roles',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':name},'rules':[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':[resource],'verbs':verbs}]})
    c.create(f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':name},'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':name},'subjects':[{'kind':'Group' if group else 'User','apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','name':user}]})


def configmap(c,ns,name=None,**extra):
    obj={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':name or token('cm')},'data':{'payload':token('value')}}
    for key,value in extra.items():
        if key=='metadata':obj['metadata'].update(value)
        else:obj[key]=value
    return c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps',obj)


def pod(c,ns,name=None):
    return c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/pods',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':name or token('pod')},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/not-pulled'}]}})


class Session:
    def __enter__(self):
        self.c=Cluster();self.trace=[];self.ns=token('batch');self.c.namespace(self.ns)
        self.base_ns=token('baseline');self.c.namespace(self.base_ns)
        self.base=configmap(self.c,self.base_ns)
        grant(self.c,self.base_ns,'configmaps',['get'])
        self.base_path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{self.base_ns}/configmaps/'+self.base['metadata']['name']
        for _ in range(40):
            if self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')[0]==200:break
            time.sleep(.05)
        assert self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:batch2-kubernetes',flush=True)
        return self

    def api(self,method,path,value=None,ctype='application/json',identity='admin'):
        code,result=self.c.request(method,path,value,identity,ctype)
        self.trace.append({'method':method,'path':path,'status':code})
        return code,result

    def runner(self,args):
        assert isinstance(args,list) and args and args[0] in ('kubectl','openssl')
        proc=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
        self.trace.append({'args':args,'status':proc.returncode})
        return proc.returncode,proc.stdout,proc.stderr

    def __exit__(self,typ,value,tb):
        try:
            if typ is None:
                code,current=self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')
                assert code==200 and current==self.base,'original permission or baseline object regressed'
                print('ORIGINAL_ACCESS_AND_DATA_RETAINED',flush=True)
        finally:self.c.close()


def kubeconfig(c,path,namespace,context='default'):
    value={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Config','clusters':[{'name':'private','cluster':{'server':c.url,'certificate-authority':str(c.root/'ca.crt')}}],'users':[{'name':'private-admin','user':{'client-certificate':str(c.root/'admin.crt'),'client-key':str(c.root/'admin.key')}}],'contexts':[{'name':context,'context':{'cluster':'private','user':'private-admin','namespace':namespace}}],'current-context':context}
    pathlib.Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value));pathlib.Path(path).chmod(0o600)
    return value

        user,group=token('person'),token('team')
        grant(s.c,s.ns,'configmaps',['get'],user=group,group=True)
        obj=configmap(s.c,s.ns)
        key=s.c.root/'subject.key';csr=s.c.root/'subject.csr';crt=s.c.root/'subject.crt'
        s.c.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        result=student()(s.runner,{'username':user,'group':group,'key':str(key),'csr':str(csr)})
        assert pathlib.Path(result)==csr and csr.is_file()
        subject=s.c.run('openssl','req','-in',str(csr),'-noout','-subject','-nameopt','RFC2253').stdout

def check_export():
    with Session() as s:
        originals=[]
        for _ in range(5):
            originals.append(s.c.create('/api/v1/nodes',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Node','metadata':{'name':token('node'),'labels':{'owner':token('team')}}}))
        folder=s.c.root/'export';folder.mkdir();occupied=folder/'occupied.json';occupied.write_text('KEEP ORIGINAL')
        def api(method,path,value=None,ctype='application/json'):
            result=s.api(method,path,value,ctype)
            if len(s.trace)==1:s.c.create('/api/v1/nodes',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Node','metadata':{'name':token('late')}})

        # Start a separate snapshot after the exclusive-open refusal, so the
        # continuation invariant is tied to the first actual export request.
        s.trace.clear()
        expected=s.c.request('GET','/api/v1/nodes')[1]['items']

        count=student()(api,{'output':str(output),'limit':2})
        saved=json.loads(output.read_text())
        assert saved['kind']=='NodeList' and saved['apiVersion']=='v1' and count==len(expected)
        assert {x['metadata']['uid']:x for x in saved['items']}=={x['metadata']['uid']:x for x in expected}

def check_client_dryrun():
    with Session() as s:
        path=s.c.root/'offline-kubeconfig.json'
        config=kubeconfig(s.c,path,s.ns)
        # kubectl run v1.34 resolves REST mappings even for a client dry-run.
        # Prime its real discovery cache, then stop the real API listener.
        # This is an explicit prerequisite, not fabricated discovery JSON.
        cache=s.c.root/'native-discovery-cache'
        s.c.run('kubectl','--kubeconfig',str(path),'--cache-dir',str(cache),'run',token('cache-primer'),'--image=invalid.local/never-run','--restart=Never','--dry-run=client','-o','json')
        before=path.read_bytes()
        name,image=token('offline'),'example.invalid/app@sha256:'+secrets.token_hex(32)
        s.c.api.terminate();s.c.api.wait(timeout=10)
        print('NATIVE_API_STOPPED_AFTER_REAL_DISCOVERY_CACHE_PRIME',flush=True)
        try:
            result=student()(s.runner,{'config':str(path),'cache':str(cache),'name':name,'image':image,'environment':'VALUE WITH SPACES'})
        finally:s.c.restart_api(json.loads(s.c.encryption_path.read_text()))
        assert result['kind']=='Pod' and result['metadata']['name']==name
        assert result['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image
        assert result['spec']['restartPolicy']=='Never'
        assert {'name':'MESSAGE','value':'VALUE WITH SPACES'} in result['spec']['containers'][0]['env']
        assert path.read_bytes()==before and s.c.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods')[1]['items']==[]
        assert any('--dry-run=client' in x.get('args',[]) for x in s.trace)

        bad['contexts'][0]['context']['namespace']=denied_ns;forbidden.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
        paths={'tls':str(badca),'authentication':str(noauth),'authorization':str(forbidden),'success':str(good)}
        originals={name:pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes() for name,path in paths.items()}
        result=student()(s.runner,{'configs':paths,'name':item['metadata']['name']})
        assert result=={'tls':'TLS','authentication':'AUTHENTICATION','authorization':'AUTHORIZATION','success':item['metadata']['uid']}
        assert all(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()==originals[name] for name,path in paths.items())
        assert len(s.trace)==4 and len({tuple(x['args']) for x in s.trace})==4
        assert all('--insecure-skip-tls-verify' not in ' '.join(x['args']) for x in s.trace)


def check_deletion():
    with Session() as s:
        obj=pod(s.c,s.ns);name=obj['metadata']['name'];path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/{name}'
        ours='training.example.com/'+token('owned');foreign='other.example.com/keep'
        assert s.c.request('PATCH',path,{'metadata':{'finalizers':[ours,foreign]}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json')[0]==200
        before=s.c.request('GET',path)[1]
        # Ask for deletion with zero grace only in this node-free private API
        # fixture; finalizers must still retain the API object.
        assert s.c.request('DELETE',path,{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'DeleteOptions','gracePeriodSeconds':0,'preconditions':{'uid':obj['metadata']['uid']}})[0] in (200,202)
        current=s.c.request('GET',path)[1]
        assert current['metadata']['deletionTimestamp'] and set(current['metadata']['finalizers'])=={ours,foreign}
        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'uid':obj['metadata']['uid'],'owned_finalizer':ours})
        remaining=s.c.request('GET',path)[1]
        assert result=={'api_deleted':False,'process_exit_verified':False}
        assert remaining['metadata']['uid']==obj['metadata']['uid'] and remaining['metadata']['finalizers']==[foreign]
        assert remaining['spec']==before['spec']
        assert s.c.request('DELETE',path,{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'DeleteOptions','preconditions':{'uid':token('wrong-uid')}})[0]==409
        assert s.c.request('GET',path)[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FINALIZER_AND_UID_DELETE_PRECONDITION; NO_KUBELET_PROCESS_CLAIM')


def execute(case):
    globals()['check_'+case]()
    print('ALL_BATCH2_NATIVE_KUBERNETES_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',case)

```python
import urllib.parse
def solve(api,case):
    document={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':case['name'],'namespace':case['namespace']},'data':{'protected':case['desired']}}
    path=case['path']+'?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'fieldManager':case['manager'],'force':'false'})
    code,result=api('PATCH',path,document,'application/apply-patch+yaml')
    assert code==409,result
    document['data']={'owned':case['owned']}
    code,result=api('PATCH',path,document,'application/apply-patch+yaml')
    assert code==200,result
    return True
```

## 初始环境
隔离Linux非root、kube-apiserver v1.34.1、etcd3.6.4、kubectl1.34.1、OpenSSL、Python标准库。固定检查器自启私有mTLS控制面，2GiB/2CPU，无外网。所有名称、身份、数据和路径由验收动态产生。run(argv)返回(exitcode,stdout,stderr)，api(method,path,value=None,content_type="application/json")返回真实HTTP码和解析JSON。

## 操作任务

## 交付产物
task.py，仅修改该文件，不得修改checks或固定输入。

原生组件READY后核对真实状态、动态输入、拒绝路径及原有访问/数据保持；平台参考、骨架、典型错误、提前exit0四路，另有独立反例。

仅执行题内真实API/etcd/OpenSSL/kubectl机制。没有scheduler、controller-manager、kubelet、CRI、CNI或CSI；API对象及受控status写入不能证明实际Pod运行、卷挂载或业务健康。不连接外部集群，不读取或更改宿主默认kubeconfig。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

"""Sixteen distinct native API contracts; no node-runtime results are simulated."""
import base64
import copy
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.parse
from native import Cluster


def student():
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',pathlib.Path('task.py').resolve())
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.solve


def token(prefix='x'):return prefix+'-'+secrets.token_hex(5)


def grant(c,ns,resource,verbs,user='opsforge-pilot-user',group=False):
    name=token('role')
    c.create(f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/roles',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':name},'rules':[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':[resource],'verbs':verbs}]})
    c.create(f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':name},'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':name},'subjects':[{'kind':'Group' if group else 'User','apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','name':user}]})


def configmap(c,ns,name=None,**extra):
    obj={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':name or token('cm')},'data':{'payload':token('value')}}
    for key,value in extra.items():
        if key=='metadata':obj['metadata'].update(value)
        else:obj[key]=value
    return c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps',obj)


def pod(c,ns,name=None):
    return c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/pods',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':name or token('pod')},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/not-pulled'}]}})


class Session:
    def __enter__(self):
        self.c=Cluster();self.trace=[];self.ns=token('batch');self.c.namespace(self.ns)
        self.base_ns=token('baseline');self.c.namespace(self.base_ns)
        self.base=configmap(self.c,self.base_ns)
        grant(self.c,self.base_ns,'configmaps',['get'])
        self.base_path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{self.base_ns}/configmaps/'+self.base['metadata']['name']
        for _ in range(40):
            if self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')[0]==200:break
            time.sleep(.05)
        assert self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:batch2-kubernetes',flush=True)
        return self

    def api(self,method,path,value=None,ctype='application/json',identity='admin'):
        code,result=self.c.request(method,path,value,identity,ctype)
        self.trace.append({'method':method,'path':path,'status':code})
        return code,result

    def runner(self,args):
        assert isinstance(args,list) and args and args[0] in ('kubectl','openssl')
        proc=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
        self.trace.append({'args':args,'status':proc.returncode})
        return proc.returncode,proc.stdout,proc.stderr

    def __exit__(self,typ,value,tb):
        try:
            if typ is None:
                code,current=self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')
                assert code==200 and current==self.base,'original permission or baseline object regressed'
                print('ORIGINAL_ACCESS_AND_DATA_RETAINED',flush=True)
        finally:self.c.close()


def kubeconfig(c,path,namespace,context='default'):
    value={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Config','clusters':[{'name':'private','cluster':{'server':c.url,'certificate-authority':str(c.root/'ca.crt')}}],'users':[{'name':'private-admin','user':{'client-certificate':str(c.root/'admin.crt'),'client-key':str(c.root/'admin.key')}}],'contexts':[{'name':context,'context':{'cluster':'private','user':'private-admin','namespace':namespace}}],'current-context':context}
    pathlib.Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value));pathlib.Path(path).chmod(0o600)
    return value


def check_identity():
    with Session() as s:
        user,group=token('person'),token('team')
        grant(s.c,s.ns,'configmaps',['get'],user=group,group=True)
        obj=configmap(s.c,s.ns)
        key=s.c.root/'subject.key';csr=s.c.root/'subject.csr';crt=s.c.root/'subject.crt'
        s.c.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        result=student()(s.runner,{'username':user,'group':group,'key':str(key),'csr':str(csr)})
        assert pathlib.Path(result)==csr and csr.is_file()
        subject=s.c.run('openssl','req','-in',str(csr),'-noout','-subject','-nameopt','RFC2253').stdout
        fields=[x.strip() for x in subject.split('=',1)[1].strip().split(',')]
        assert len(fields)==2 and set(fields)=={'CN='+user,'O='+group},subject
        ext=s.c.root/'subject.ext';ext.write_text('extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n')
        s.c.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(s.c.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(s.c.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps/'+obj['metadata']['name']
        assert s.c.request('GET',path,identity='subject')[0]==200
        assert s.c.request('GET','/api/v1/users')[0]==404
        assert s.c.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/secrets',identity='subject')[0]==403
        print('NATIVE_CERTIFICATE_IDENTITY_AND_SCOPED_ACCESS_VERIFIED')


def check_labels():
    with Session() as s:
        key='app.example.com/'+token('role');wanted=token('selected')
        target=configmap(s.c,s.ns,metadata={'labels':{'owner':'preserve'},'annotations':{'audit':token('keep')}})
        other=configmap(s.c,s.ns,metadata={'labels':{key:'other'}})
        path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps/'+target['metadata']['name']
        before=copy.deepcopy(target)
        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'collection':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps','key':key,'value':wanted})
        current=s.c.request('GET',path)[1]
        assert current['metadata']['labels']=={'owner':'preserve',key:wanted}
        assert current['metadata']['annotations']==before['metadata']['annotations'] and current['data']==before['data']
        assert current['metadata']['uid']==before['metadata']['uid']
        assert result==[target['metadata']['name']]
        assert s.c.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps/'+other['metadata']['name'])[1]==other
        assert any('labelSelector=' in x.get('path','') and x['status']==200 for x in s.trace)


def check_annotations():
    with Session() as s:
        key='trace.example.com/'+token('tag');value=token('trace');note='中文\n'+secrets.token_hex(110)
        target=configmap(s.c,s.ns,metadata={'labels':{'owner':'untouched'},'annotations':{'keep':token('old')}})
        decoy=configmap(s.c,s.ns,metadata={'labels':{key:value}})
        path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps/'+target['metadata']['name']
        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'collection':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps','key':key,'value':value,'note':note})
        current=s.c.request('GET',path)[1]
        assert current['metadata']['labels']==target['metadata']['labels']
        assert current['metadata']['annotations']=={**target['metadata']['annotations'],key:value,'description':note}
        assert result==[decoy['metadata']['name']],'annotation values must not be treated as selector labels'
        assert current['data']==target['data']


def check_namespaces():
    with Session() as s:
        other=token('private');s.c.namespace(other)
        own=pod(s.c,s.ns);pod(s.c,other)
        grant(s.c,s.ns,'pods',['get','list'])
        def api(method,path,value=None,ctype='application/json'):
            return s.api(method,path,value,ctype,identity='learner')
        result=student()(api,{'namespace':s.ns,'other_namespace':other})
        assert result=={'local':[own['metadata']['name']],'other_status':403,'all_status':403}
        observed={(x['method'],x['path']):x['status'] for x in s.trace}
        assert observed=={('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods'):200,('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{other}/pods'):403,('GET','/api/v1/pods'):403}


def check_export():
    with Session() as s:
        originals=[]
        for _ in range(5):
            originals.append(s.c.create('/api/v1/nodes',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Node','metadata':{'name':token('node'),'labels':{'owner':token('team')}}}))

answer:
```python
import json,pathlib,os
def solve(run,case):
    path=pathlib.Path(case['path']);config=json.loads(path.read_text())
    config['clusters'].append({'name':case['cluster_name'],'cluster':{'server':case['server'],'certificate-authority':case['ca']}})
    config['users'].append({'name':case['user_name'],'user':{'client-certificate':case['cert'],'client-key':case['key']}})
    config['contexts'].append({'name':case['context_name'],'context':{'cluster':case['cluster_name'],'user':case['user_name'],'namespace':case['namespace']}})
    temporary=path.with_suffix('.next');temporary.write_text(json.dumps(config));temporary.chmod(0o600);temporary.replace(path)
    return {'context':case['context_name'],'namespace':case['namespace']}
```

## 原题原理与边界
kubeconfig 保存或引用集群 API 地址、CA、用户凭据和 context 关系。它不是集群所有配置的备份，也可能含高权限凭据。区分当前 context 和默认 namespace，限制文件读取权限，不公开上传。

## 初始环境
隔离Linux非root、kube-apiserver v1.34.1、etcd3.6.4、kubectl1.34.1、OpenSSL、Python标准库。固定检查器自启私有mTLS控制面，2GiB/2CPU，无外网。所有名称、身份、数据和路径由验收动态产生。run(argv)返回(exitcode,stdout,stderr)，api(method,path,value=None,content_type="application/json")返回真实HTTP码和解析JSON。

## 交付产物
task.py，仅修改该文件，不得修改checks或固定输入。

import base64

import socket
import ssl

import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()

    with Cluster() as cluster:

"""Sixteen distinct native API contracts; no node-runtime results are simulated."""
import base64
import copy
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.parse
from native import Cluster


def student():
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',pathlib.Path('task.py').resolve())
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.solve


def token(prefix='x'):return prefix+'-'+secrets.token_hex(5)


def grant(c,ns,resource,verbs,user='opsforge-pilot-user',group=False):
    name=token('role')
    c.create(f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/roles',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':name},'rules':[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':[resource],'verbs':verbs}]})
    c.create(f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':name},'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':name},'subjects':[{'kind':'Group' if group else 'User','apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','name':user}]})


def configmap(c,ns,name=None,**extra):
    obj={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':name or token('cm')},'data':{'payload':token('value')}}
    for key,value in extra.items():
        if key=='metadata':obj['metadata'].update(value)
        else:obj[key]=value
    return c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps',obj)


def pod(c,ns,name=None):
    return c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/pods',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':name or token('pod')},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/not-pulled'}]}})


class Session:
    def __enter__(self):
        self.c=Cluster();self.trace=[];self.ns=token('batch');self.c.namespace(self.ns)
        self.base_ns=token('baseline');self.c.namespace(self.base_ns)
        self.base=configmap(self.c,self.base_ns)
        grant(self.c,self.base_ns,'configmaps',['get'])
        self.base_path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{self.base_ns}/configmaps/'+self.base['metadata']['name']
        for _ in range(40):
            if self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')[0]==200:break
            time.sleep(.05)
        assert self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:batch2-kubernetes',flush=True)
        return self

    def api(self,method,path,value=None,ctype='application/json',identity='admin'):
        code,result=self.c.request(method,path,value,identity,ctype)
        self.trace.append({'method':method,'path':path,'status':code})
        return code,result

    def runner(self,args):
        assert isinstance(args,list) and args and args[0] in ('kubectl','openssl')
        proc=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
        self.trace.append({'args':args,'status':proc.returncode})
        return proc.returncode,proc.stdout,proc.stderr

    def __exit__(self,typ,value,tb):
        try:
            if typ is None:
                code,current=self.c.request('GET',self.base_path,identity='learner')
                assert code==200 and current==self.base,'original permission or baseline object regressed'
                print('ORIGINAL_ACCESS_AND_DATA_RETAINED',flush=True)
        finally:self.c.close()


def kubeconfig(c,path,namespace,context='default'):
    value={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Config','clusters':[{'name':'private','cluster':{'server':c.url,'certificate-authority':str(c.root/'ca.crt')}}],'users':[{'name':'private-admin','user':{'client-certificate':str(c.root/'admin.crt'),'client-key':str(c.root/'admin.key')}}],'contexts':[{'name':context,'context':{'cluster':'private','user':'private-admin','namespace':namespace}}],'current-context':context}
    pathlib.Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value));pathlib.Path(path).chmod(0o600)
    return value

def check_export():
    with Session() as s:
        originals=[]
        for _ in range(5):
            originals.append(s.c.create('/api/v1/nodes',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Node','metadata':{'name':token('node'),'labels':{'owner':token('team')}}}))

        obj=s.c.create(f'/apis/{group}/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/{plural}',{'apiVersion':group+'/v1','kind':'InventoryObject','metadata':{'name':token('inventory')},'spec':{'value':secrets.randbelow(100)}})
        result=student()(s.api,{'group':group,'version':'v1','namespace':s.ns,'plural':plural})
        assert result=={'namespaced':True,'categories':[],'objects':[obj['metadata']['name']]}
        assert any(x['path']==f'/apis/{group}/v1' and x['status']==200 for x in s.trace)
        assert any(x['path']==f'/apis/{group}/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/{plural}' and x['status']==200 for x in s.trace)
        # This CRD deliberately has no all category, although it is discoverable.
        assert not next(x for x in discovery['resources'] if x['name']==plural).get('categories')


def check_replicaset():
    with Session() as s:
        name=token('replicaset');label=token('app')
        bad={'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'ReplicaCet','metadata':{'name':name},'spec':{'replicas':2,'selector':{'matchLabels':{'tier':label}},'template':{'metadata':{'labels':{'tier':'mismatch','preserve':token('label')}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/retained'}]}}}}
        collection=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets'

        assert code==200 and result==current['metadata']['uid']
        assert current['kind']=='ReplicaSet' and current['spec']['selector']==bad['spec']['selector']
        assert current['spec']['template']['metadata']['labels']=={**bad['spec']['template']['metadata']['labels'],'tier':label}
        assert current['spec']==canonical['spec'],'compare server-defaulted spec, not the incomplete input container'
        changed=copy.deepcopy(current);changed['spec']['selector']['matchLabels']['tier']=token('new')
        changed['spec']['template']['metadata']['labels']['tier']=changed['spec']['selector']['matchLabels']['tier']
        assert s.c.request('PUT',collection+'/'+name,changed)[0]==422,'selector immutable rule must be native'

def check_storageclass():
    with Session() as s:
        name=token('storage');new_name=token('storage-v2')
        old=s.c.create('/apis/storage.k8s.io/v1/storageclasses',{'apiVersion':'storage.k8s.io/v1','kind':'StorageClass','metadata':{'name':name},'provisioner':'csi.example.com/training','parameters':{'tier':'old','encryption':'required'},'reclaimPolicy':'Retain','volumeBindingMode':'WaitForFirstConsumer','allowVolumeExpansion':True})

        assert result==new_name and s.c.request('GET','/apis/storage.k8s.io/v1/storageclasses/'+name)[1]==old
        code,new=s.c.request('GET','/apis/storage.k8s.io/v1/storageclasses/'+new_name)
        assert code==200 and new['parameters']==parameters
        for key in ('provisioner','reclaimPolicy','volumeBindingMode','allowVolumeExpansion'):assert new[key]==old[key]
        assert new['metadata']['uid']!=old['metadata']['uid']
        assert any(x['status']==422 for x in s.trace),'must observe immutable parameters rejection before creating a new class'
        print('NATIVE_STORAGECLASS_IMMUTABILITY_ONLY; NO_CSI_PROVISIONING')


def check_client_dryrun():
    with Session() as s:
        path=s.c.root/'offline-kubeconfig.json'
        config=kubeconfig(s.c,path,s.ns)
        # kubectl run v1.34 resolves REST mappings even for a client dry-run.
        # Prime its real discovery cache, then stop the real API listener.
        # This is an explicit prerequisite, not fabricated discovery JSON.
        cache=s.c.root/'native-discovery-cache'
        s.c.run('kubectl','--kubeconfig',str(path),'--cache-dir',str(cache),'run',token('cache-primer'),'--image=invalid.local/never-run','--restart=Never','--dry-run=client','-o','json')
        before=path.read_bytes()
        name,image=token('offline'),'example.invalid/app@sha256:'+secrets.token_hex(32)
        s.c.api.terminate();s.c.api.wait(timeout=10)
        print('NATIVE_API_STOPPED_AFTER_REAL_DISCOVERY_CACHE_PRIME',flush=True)
        try:
            result=student()(s.runner,{'config':str(path),'cache':str(cache),'name':name,'image':image,'environment':'VALUE WITH SPACES'})
        finally:s.c.restart_api(json.loads(s.c.encryption_path.read_text()))
        assert result['kind']=='Pod' and result['metadata']['name']==name
        assert result['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image
        assert result['spec']['restartPolicy']=='Never'
        assert {'name':'MESSAGE','value':'VALUE WITH SPACES'} in result['spec']['containers'][0]['env']
        assert path.read_bytes()==before and s.c.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods')[1]['items']==[]
        assert any('--dry-run=client' in x.get('args',[]) for x in s.trace)


def check_kubectl():
    with Session() as s:
        grant(s.c,s.ns,'configmaps',['get','patch'])
        item=configmap(s.c,s.ns);other=token('forbidden');s.c.namespace(other);configmap(s.c,other,item['metadata']['name'])

        value['users'][0]['user']={'client-certificate':str(s.c.root/'learner.crt'),'client-key':str(s.c.root/'learner.key')}
        value['contexts'].append({'name':'scoped-operation','context':{'cluster':'private','user':'private-admin','namespace':s.ns}})
        path.write_text(json.dumps(value));before=path.read_bytes()
        value_to_write=token('new')
        result=student()(s.runner,{'config':str(path),'context':'scoped-operation','namespace':s.ns,'other_namespace':other,'name':item['metadata']['name'],'value':value_to_write})

        now=s.c.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps/'+item['metadata']['name'])[1]
        assert now['data']['payload']==value_to_write and now['metadata']['uid']==item['metadata']['uid']
        denied=s.c.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{other}/configmaps/'+item['metadata']['name'])[1]
        assert denied['data']['payload']!=value_to_write
        assert any(x['status']!=0 and other in x.get('args',[]) for x in s.trace)


def check_chain():
    with Session() as s:
        grant(s.c,s.ns,'configmaps',['get'])
        item=configmap(s.c,s.ns)
        good=s.c.root/'good.json';value=kubeconfig(s.c,good,s.ns)
        value['users'][0]['user']={'client-certificate':str(s.c.root/'learner.crt'),'client-key':str(s.c.root/'learner.key')}
        good.write_text(json.dumps(value))
        badca=s.c.root/'badca.json';bad=copy.deepcopy(value)
        wrongca=s.c.root/'wrongca.crt';wrongkey=s.c.root/'wrongca.key'
        s.c.run('openssl','req','-x509','-newkey','ec','-pkeyopt','ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1','-nodes','-keyout',str(wrongkey),'-out',str(wrongca),'-days','1','-subj','/CN=UnrelatedCA')
        bad['clusters'][0]['cluster']['certificate-authority']=str(wrongca);badca.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
        noauth=s.c.root/'noauth.json';bad=copy.deepcopy(value);bad['users'][0]['user']={'token':token('invalid-token')};noauth.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
        forbidden=s.c.root/'forbidden.json';bad=copy.deepcopy(value);bad['contexts'][0]['context']['namespace']=s.base_ns;forbidden.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
        # Baseline namespace is readable, so use an actual ungranted namespace.
        denied_ns=token('denied');s.c.namespace(denied_ns);configmap(s.c,denied_ns,item['metadata']['name'])
        bad['contexts'][0]['context']['namespace']=denied_ns;forbidden.write_text(json.dumps(bad))
        paths={'tls':str(badca),'authentication':str(noauth),'authorization':str(forbidden),'success':str(good)}
        originals={name:pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes() for name,path in paths.items()}
        result=student()(s.runner,{'configs':paths,'name':item['metadata']['name']})
        assert result=={'tls':'TLS','authentication':'AUTHENTICATION','authorization':'AUTHORIZATION','success':item['metadata']['uid']}
        assert all(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()==originals[name] for name,path in paths.items())
        assert len(s.trace)==4 and len({tuple(x['args']) for x in s.trace})==4
        assert all('--insecure-skip-tls-verify' not in ' '.join(x['args']) for x in s.trace)


def check_deletion():
    with Session() as s:
        obj=pod(s.c,s.ns);name=obj['metadata']['name'];path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/{name}'
        ours='training.example.com/'+token('owned');foreign='other.example.com/keep'
        assert s.c.request('PATCH',path,{'metadata':{'finalizers':[ours,foreign]}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json')[0]==200
        before=s.c.request('GET',path)[1]
        # Ask for deletion with zero grace only in this node-free private API
        # fixture; finalizers must still retain the API object.
        assert s.c.request('DELETE',path,{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'DeleteOptions','gracePeriodSeconds':0,'preconditions':{'uid':obj['metadata']['uid']}})[0] in (200,202)
        current=s.c.request('GET',path)[1]
        assert current['metadata']['deletionTimestamp'] and set(current['metadata']['finalizers'])=={ours,foreign}
        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'uid':obj['metadata']['uid'],'owned_finalizer':ours})
        remaining=s.c.request('GET',path)[1]
        assert result=={'api_deleted':False,'process_exit_verified':False}
        assert remaining['metadata']['uid']==obj['metadata']['uid'] and remaining['metadata']['finalizers']==[foreign]
        assert remaining['spec']==before['spec']
        assert s.c.request('DELETE',path,{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'DeleteOptions','preconditions':{'uid':token('wrong-uid')}})[0]==409
        assert s.c.request('GET',path)[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FINALIZER_AND_UID_DELETE_PRECONDITION; NO_KUBELET_PROCESS_CLAIM')

    globals()['check_'+case]()
